transform_transpose: transform a Transpose constraint by swapping two dimension indices and generating validity checks
transform_index_select: transform an IndexSelect constraint by validating an index and replacing the input dimension with a new one
transform_get_item: transform a GetItem constraint by validating an index and generating an equality for the extracted item dimension
transform_get_item_tensor: transform a GetItemTensor constraint with a tuple index, handling None insertions and slice dimensions
generate_binconstraint_t: transform a BinConstraintT by applying precision, matching, consistency, or leq operations on tensor types
generate_binconstraint_d: transform a BinConstraintD by applying precision or consistency operations on dimension variables
generate_conj: transform a conjunction of constraints by recursively transforming each conjunct
generate_disj: transform a disjunction of constraints by recursively transforming each disjunct
generate_gub: transform a tensor greatest upper bound into a disjunction of equality and GUB constraints
generate_d_gub: transform a dimension greatest upper bound into a disjunction of equality constraints
generate_calc_conv: transform a CalcConv constraint into equality and arithmetic constraints for convolution output dimensions
generate_calc_maxpool: transform a CalcMaxPool constraint into equality and arithmetic constraints for maxpool output dimensions
generate_calc_product: transform a flatten/reshape product constraint by generating all int and dynamic dimension possibilities
generate_reshape: transform a CanReshape constraint by considering all input tensor sizes and dynamic dimension possibilities
generate_broadcasting: transform an ApplyBroadcasting constraint by generating all padding and broadcasting dimension possibilities
transform_constraint: dispatch a constraint to the registered transformation rule based on its type
register_transformation_rule: register a transformation function for a specific constraint type in the transformation rules registry
calc_last_two_dims: generate constraints for the last two dimensions of a convolution or maxpool output using stride, padding, and kernel parameters
gen_broadcasting_constraints: generate broadcasting constraints for two inputs by simulating all padding and dimension possibilities
gen_greatest_upper_bound: generate greatest upper bound constraints for tensors by iterating over all possible ranks up to MAX_TENSOR_RANK
